note:
Continuing on with the analsys of how much effort it took to create monument valley.
From the estimate, it about 10k people hours (pplh). Assume $50 / hour labor cost (~$100k/year) gives $500k to produce. Round up for $1M.
10k pplh for a 5-10 person team gives 25-50 weeks (@ 40h/week) or about six months to a year.
Summary is that it takes about 10k people hours, $1M, and 5-10 person team six months to a year to develop.
